definitions.explanation: The residence of an emperor or empress. In Japan, specifically the palace of the Japanese emperor.

examples.japanese: {皇宮|こうぐう}⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Imperial Guard Police are providing security.

examples.japanese: {皇宮|こうぐう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people jog around the imperial palace.

examples.japanese: {皇宮|こうぐう}{護衛官|ごえいかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦{陛下|へいか}→陛下：14566_heika⟧や⟦{皇族|こうぞく}→皇族：22657_kouzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身辺|しんぺん}→身辺：14823_shinpen⟧⟦{警護|けいご}→警護：23440_keigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{警察官|けいさつかん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧だ。
examples.english: Imperial Palace guards are special police officers responsible for the personal security of the Emperor and the Imperial Family.

notes:
A compound of {皇|こう} (emperor, imperial) and {宮|ぐう} (palace). While ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→皇居：13607_koukyo⟧ is the standard term for the current Imperial Palace in Tokyo, {皇宮|こうぐう} appears in official titles and compound terms, particularly in the name of the {皇宮警察|こうぐうけいさつ} (Imperial Guard Police).

The {皇宮警察|こうぐうけいさつ} is a special police force under the National Police Agency that guards the Imperial Palace and protects the Imperial Family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇宮|こうぐう}⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧: Imperial Guard Police
- {皇宮|こうぐう}{護衛官|ごえいかん}: Imperial Palace guard
- {皇宮|こうぐう}⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧: Imperial Palace security

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皇居|こうきょ}→皇居：13607_koukyo⟧: the Imperial Palace (Tokyo) — the standard modern term for the Emperor's residence
- ⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧: palace — general term for any grand royal or imperial palace
- ⟦{御所|ごしょ}→御所：12847_gosho⟧: imperial residence — used for both the Kyoto Imperial Palace and as a respectful term
